memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: “He will wipe every tear from their eyes.”  ( Revelation 21:4 )

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Tears are an outward language of the inner heart sometimes pain, sometimes joy, sometimes spiritual brokenness. Jesus Himself cried over Jerusalem because of their stubbornness and spiritual blindness. In prayer, tears carry deep meaning in Heaven.
Every tear that falls from a believer’s eyes becomes a seed for God to release a greater blessing. When you can’t express your pain in words, your tears speak louder in Heaven than your voice on earth. The saints who cried for lost souls poured their tears into the presence of God, and He remembered them. No tear given to God returns empty; He transforms them into strength, healing, and supernatural comfort.
Even tears from worldly sorrow or the loss of loved ones are seen by God. His love is greater than a mother’s; His comfort wipes the eyes and heals the heart. Let us trust His loving hands and surrender fully.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: “God never ignores the tears of His children; they are silent prayers that go straight to His heart.”  ( Charles Spurgeon )

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, I bring every tear before You. Wipe my eyes, strengthen my heart, and turn my sorrow into testimony. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: May the Lord who sees every unseen tear lift you up today. May His love surround you and restore your joy.
